subject: general
question: Which island nation lies to the south of the Lakshadweep Islands?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Maldives**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Maldives** is an island nation located in the **Indian Ocean**, southwest of India and Sri Lanka.
 
• The Maldives lies **south of the Lakshadweep Islands**, which are part of India.
 
• It is composed of **1,192 coral islands** grouped into 26 atolls, stretching over approximately **298 square kilometers.**
 
• The Maldives is famous for its **white sandy beaches** and **crystal-clear waters,** making it a popular tourist destination worldwide.
 
• The country’s capital is **Malé,** which is the most populated city in the Maldives.
 
• The Maldives has a rich marine ecosystem, with a variety of **coral reefs, fish species, and marine life.**
 
• The economy of Maldives is heavily dependent on **tourism** and **fisheries.**
 
• Its geographical location makes it vulnerable to **climate change**, especially rising sea levels.
 
• The Maldives is also known for its **underwater tourism** activities, such as snorkeling and scuba diving.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Andaman Islands**__

 __
 
• The **Andaman Islands** are located in the Bay of Bengal and are part of the Union Territory of India known as the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• They are located to the **east of mainland India**, not south of Lakshadweep.
 
• The islands are known for their **tribal groups, biodiversity, and pristine beaches.**
 
• Port Blair is the capital of the Andaman Islands.
 
 
 
• **Sri Lanka**__
 __
 
• **Sri Lanka** is an island nation in the Indian Ocean, located to the **south of India.**
 
• It is situated southeast of the Lakshadweep Islands, not directly south.
 
• Sri Lanka is known for its rich cultural heritage, tea plantations, and ancient ruins such as **Anuradhapura** and **Sigiriya.**
 
• The capital of Sri Lanka is **Colombo,** and the administrative capital is **Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte.**
 
 
 
• **Mauritius**__
 
 
• **Mauritius** is an island nation located in the **Indian Ocean, east of Madagascar.**
 
• It is not geographically close to Lakshadweep Islands.
 
• The country is famous for its **lagoon beaches, coral reefs, and volcanic interior.**
 
• Port Louis is the capital of Mauritius.
